text:
Nina L: Heads up — noticed a 37% delta between invoice preview and final for tenant qux-app around 02:14 UTC. Preview shows duplicate token rows.
Rafael M: Any edge churn or load balancer changes?
Nina L: Ops did a quick autoscale and cycled a few egress hosts at 02:12.
ops-bot: event: egress-pool-scaleup pool=us-east-1a action=cycle started_by=ops-team
Rafael M: Our preview dedupe key currently = [client_ip, api_key, session_id]. If client_ip changes on egress rotation we can emit duplicate preview events.
Nina L: Final ledger dedupe uses req_id later in pipeline, so preview wins earlier and shows duplicates.
Rafael M: Quick mitigation: pin egress for that pool for 30m and mute preview alerts for affected tenants.
Nina L: Medium fix: change preview dedupe to prefer X-Request-Id when present, else compute payload_hash (model + first_128 tokens + tenant_id). Gate payload_hash to only when req_id absent to save CPU.
billing-bot: metric: billing.preview_delta_pct{tenant="qux-app"} = 37.2
Support Bot: action: create INC-4211 for customer outreach and mark potential false positives
Rafael M: I'll open PR for feature-flagged dedupe-v2 and a telemetry counter for events using payload_hash. Plan: shadow dedupe in prod 1h -> enable for 2% tenants.
Nina L: Also add a console banner when preview != final with link to runbook and last egress change. That should cut down tickets.
Rafael M: Agreed. Assigning follow-ups: PR-5490 (dedupe-v2), INC-4211, DASH-102 (console banner). Ops to pin egress now.
